name: orphan-surface-detector-and-cleanup
title: Add a CI orphan-surface detector and retire high-confidence unused legacy surfaces
description: Prevent Lattice from accumulating handler and command surfaces that are defined in TypeScript but unreachable from the runtime registry, while cleaning only the high-confidence stale code paths already shown to be unused. The change must not register old commands merely to satisfy a scan, and must not delete dynamic serve or smoke discovery entrypoints.
